Priority Summary
sections.content:
| Issue | Impact | Effort |
|---|---|---|
| N payroll upserts → batch | High (blocks DB pool at scale) | Medium |
| Missing AbortController | Medium (memory leak on nav) | Low |
| Dashboard caching | Medium (avoids 4 DB hits per visit) | Low |
| Leaves parallel ownership checks | Medium | Low |
| `useMemo` for payroll totals | Low (client-side only) | Low |
| Employee code race condition | High (data integrity) | Medium |
| `useCallback` for fetch helpers | Low | Low |
